adventuresText.source: You are always ready to defend your party.
adventuresText.translation: 你时刻准备保卫队伍。

adventuresText.source: When you encounter a danger event, you can take a single action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} as part of rolling initiative.
adventuresText.translation: 遇到险情事件时，你可以在掷先攻时进行一个单动作，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{举起盾牌}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{交互}。

adventuresText.source: The company does not lose 1 Endurance the first time they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{dying} condition in the segment you approach.
adventuresText.translation: 在你行进到的路段中，随行队员首次获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死}状态时，不会失去 1 耐力。

0cpMZ8Pr3gbauVUV.name: 穷极恐惧之印 Sigil of Deepest Fears

adventuresText.source: Echoes bounce endlessly through the tunnels, making every passage seem correct.
adventuresText.translation: 回声在隧道间无尽回荡，让每一条通道都仿佛是正确的道路。

adventuresText.source: Occultism (hard)
adventuresText.translation: 神秘（困难）

adventuresText.source: False Echoes
adventuresText.translation: 虚假回声 False Echoes

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, except the first attempt to Navigate after this disorientation takes a –2 circumstance penalty
adventuresText.translation: 同阶段1，但在这次迷向后首次尝试导航时承受–2环境减值

adventuresText.source: As stage 2, except the penalty increases by 2. This penalty is cumulative with each time this disorientation is experienced.
adventuresText.translation: 同阶段2，但减值增加2。每次遭受这种迷向，减值都会累积。

adventuresText.source: You tend to wounds and diseases that you may encounter on a journey.
adventuresText.translation: 你处理旅行途中可能遇到的伤势和疾病。

adventuresText.source: After a danger, the first time you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{Breathe} activity to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, or to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} after using a focus spell with the healing trait, you reduce the Endurance cost by 1.
adventuresText.translation: 险情过后，你首次使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{喘息}活动来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{治疗伤势}，或在使用具有治疗特征的聚能法术后借此@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{再聚能}时，将耐力消耗降低 1。

adventuresText.source: You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{Circumvent} using Medicine if you encounter a danger event against creatures or hazards with the disease or poison traits. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{Camp} in the segment you approach, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease} downtime activity.
adventuresText.translation: 如果遇到的险情事件涉及具有疾病或毒素特征的生物或危险，你可以尝试使用医疗进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{迂回}。如果你在此次行进的路段@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{扎营}，便可以使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{治疗疾病}休整活动。

adventuresText.source: You disguise yourself and your party to delay the consequences of travel.
adventuresText.translation: 你伪装自己与队伍，以延缓旅途中不利后果的到来。

adventuresText.source: Attempt a Deception check when you Approach the segment, attempting to disguise yourself as you come close. If you encounter a danger event that contains creatures that could be fooled by a disguise (subject to GM discretion), you use your Deception check for initiative and if your result is equal to or greater than the Perception DC of a creature in the danger event, that creature cannot take reactions against you until you take a hostile action during the danger.
adventuresText.translation: 行进到该路段时，进行一次欺骗检定，尝试在接近时伪装自己。如果遇到的险情事件包含可能受伪装蒙骗的生物（由主持人裁定），你使用该欺骗检定作为先攻。如果检定结果等于或超过险情事件中某个生物的察觉DC，那么在你于此次险情中采取敌对行动前，该生物不能对你使用反应。

adventuresText.source: You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{Circumvent} using Deception if you encounter a danger event that contains creatures that could be fooled by a disguise (subject to GM discretion), using the result of your Deception check when you approach for your result. The DC is typically a hard DC of the path’s level or the highest Perception DC among the creatures in the danger, whichever is higher.
adventuresText.translation: 如果遇到的险情事件包含可能受伪装蒙骗的生物（由主持人裁定），你可以用欺骗尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{迂回}，采用行进时的欺骗检定结果。其DC通常取路线等级对应的困难DC，或险情中所有生物的最高察觉DC，以较高者为准。

adventuresText.source: The cold snap seeps into your bones, stiffening and slowing down those who travel.
adventuresText.translation: 寒潮深入骨髓，使旅行者身体僵硬，行动迟缓。

adventuresText.source: Without the proper protection from the cold, creatures traveling are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1}.
adventuresText.translation: 若没有适当的防寒保护，旅行中的生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}。

adventuresText.source: None; if the cold lasts for more than 2 segments, creatures traveling take a –10-foot status penalty to their Speeds.
adventuresText.translation: 无；若严寒持续超过 2 个路段，旅行中的生物所有速度承受 –10 尺状态减值。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: Narrow channels appear and disappear beneath the changing tides.
adventuresText.translation: 狭窄水道随着潮汐变化时隐时现。

adventuresText.source: Sailing Lore (standard), Thievery (hard)
adventuresText.translation: 航海学识（标准）、贼活（困难）

adventuresText.source: Rising Tide
adventuresText.translation: 涨潮 Rising Tide

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, except the party experiences an inclemency
adventuresText.translation: 同阶段 1，但队伍还会遭遇恶劣环境

adventuresText.source: As stage 2, except any vehicle the party is using to travel becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{broken} and starts to sink.
adventuresText.translation: 同阶段 2，但队伍用于旅行的任何载具都会变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}，并开始下沉。

3gxBd6Ni87CjzmWs.name: 亡者钟声 Toll of the Dead

adventuresText.source: A small iron bell stands at the edge of the road at the top of a long post. Hundreds of names have been carved into the frame, despite there being no settlement, cemetery, or shrine nearby.
adventuresText.translation: 路边一根长杆顶端挂着一口小铁钟。虽然附近没有聚落、墓地或神龛，钟架上却刻着数百个名字。

adventuresText.source: Religion (hard), Society (standard), an appropriate Settlement Lore (easy)
adventuresText.translation: 宗教（困难）、社群（标准）、适当的聚落学识（简单）

adventuresText.source: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} to read the names of deceased travelers on this path (same difficulty and skills as Recall Knowledge)
adventuresText.translation: 使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{解译文书}，读出这条路线上逝去旅行者的姓名（难度和技能与回忆知识相同）

adventuresText.source: Speaking the name of a deceased traveler and ringing the bell, ringing the bell without speaking the name of a deceased traveler (detrimental).
adventuresText.translation: 说出一位逝去旅行者的姓名并敲钟，未说出逝去旅行者的姓名便敲钟（有害）。

adventuresText.source: The party misunderstands the bell’s purpose.
adventuresText.translation: 队伍误解了钟的用途。

adventuresText.source: The bell tolls of its own accord as peaceful spirits briefly appear along the road. The party is given the traveler’s blessing, gaining a +2 status to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{Survey} checks for the next 2 segments after they speak a deceased traveler’s name and ring the bell. This discovery provides its revelation benefit on subsequent journeys and ringings of the bell.
adventuresText.translation: 铁钟自行鸣响，平和的精魂在路边短暂显现。队伍获得旅行者的祝福，在说出一位逝去旅行者的姓名并敲钟之后，接下来 2 个路段内的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{勘察}检定获得 +2 状态加值。在后续旅程及再次敲钟时，这处发现仍会提供其揭示的益处。

adventuresText.source: Ancient mechanical walls rotate and slide into new positions at regular intervals.
adventuresText.translation: 古老的机械墙壁每隔一段固定时间便会旋转、滑动，移至新的位置。

adventuresText.source: Crafting (standard), Thievery (hard)
adventuresText.translation: 手艺（标准）、贼活（困难）

adventuresText.source: Mechanical Reset
adventuresText.translation: 机械重置 Mechanical Reset

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, except a randomly determined combination direction changes
adventuresText.translation: 如同阶段 1，但随机确定的一组组合方向发生变化

adventuresText.source: As stage 2
adventuresText.translation: 如同阶段 2

adventuresText.source: As stage 2, except the party experiences a danger event with a construct (subject to GM discretion)
adventuresText.translation: 如同阶段 2，但队伍遭遇一个包含构装体的险情事件（由主持人裁定）

adventuresText.source: You focus on traveling fast and safely.
adventuresText.translation: 你专注于迅速而安全地旅行。

adventuresText.source: You ignore the movement impact of inclemencies.
adventuresText.translation: 你忽略恶劣环境对移动的影响。

adventuresText.source: You do not take circumstance penalties to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{Circumvent} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{Survey} from traveling fast.
adventuresText.translation: 你不会因快速旅行而在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{迂回}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{勘察}检定中承受环境减值。

adventuresText.source: The beauty of the waterfall and surrounding wildlife and stream serve as a suitable means of protection.
adventuresText.translation: 壮丽的瀑布、周围的野生生物与溪流，为队伍提供了适当的庇护。

adventuresText.source: Attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{Camp} from the segment of this abundance receive an automatic critical success.
adventuresText.translation: 在此丰饶所在的路段尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{扎营}时，自动大成功。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

7PpkBHp7Jdrlf0tq.name: 现实边缘 Edge of Reality

adventuresText.source: (secret danger) Trigger The party fails a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{Survey} during a @UUID[.b2KiI0IRtyDRT90l]{Thunderstorm} or the party suffers the highest stage Disorientation during a navigation; Effect The party inadvertently approaches a fracture where the planes intersect and are collapsing into one another. A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.night-of-the-gray-death-bestiary.Actor.JbSbUomIHYwkqgAM]{planar eviction} hazard appears and an encounter begins.
adventuresText.translation: （隐秘险情）触发 队伍在@UUID[.b2KiI0IRtyDRT90l]{雷暴}期间@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{勘察}失败，或在导航事件中陷入最高阶段的迷向；效果 队伍无意间接近了一处裂隙，诸位面在此交错并相互坍塌。出现一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.night-of-the-gray-death-bestiary.Actor.JbSbUomIHYwkqgAM]{位面驱逐}危险，并开始一次遭遇。

adventuresText.source: You study the subject matter that you may encounter on a journey.
adventuresText.translation: 你研究旅行中可能遇到的事物。

adventuresText.source: Attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} when you Approach the segment, gaining the appropriate results if you encounter a subject you could use Recall Knowledge on in the segment.
adventuresText.translation: 你在行进该路段时尝试一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定；如果在该路段遇到可用回忆知识辨识的对象，就获得相应的结果。

adventuresText.source: You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{Circumvent} using the skill you chose to Recall Knowledge if you encounter a danger event that contains an appropriate subject, using the result of your Recall Knowledge check when you approach for your result.
adventuresText.translation: 如果遇到的险情事件包含适当的对象，你可以使用此前选择的回忆知识技能尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{迂回}，并采用行进时所作的回忆知识检定结果。

adventuresText.source: (inevitable inclemency) After the party has used @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.yI99AqcBt4JHbgmU]{Approach} twice, a @UUID[.ZJvHCUQAE2pufzSD]{severe heat} inclemency begins and lasts for the remainder of the path or until they encounter the @UUID[.DCVlus0XsEFdvRq9]{oasis}.
adventuresText.translation: （不可避免的恶劣环境）队伍使用两次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.yI99AqcBt4JHbgmU]{行进}后，开始出现@UUID[.ZJvHCUQAE2pufzSD]{严酷高温}恶劣环境，持续至此路线结束或队伍遭遇@UUID[.DCVlus0XsEFdvRq9]{绿洲}。

adventuresText.source: difficult terrain; if the snow lasts for more than 2 segments, greater difficult terrain
adventuresText.translation: 困难地形；如果降雪持续超过 2 个路段，则为高等困难地形

adventuresText.source: Visual Perception checks suffer a –2 circumstance penalty.
adventuresText.translation: 基于视觉的察觉检定承受 –2 环境减值。

adventuresText.source: Checks to Survey using Survival for dangers that include creatures have a +2 circumstance bonus.
adventuresText.translation: 针对包含生物的险情，使用生存进行勘察的检定获得 +2 环境加值。

adventuresText.source: You prepare the basic equipment, strategies, and other methods to stave off bad inclemency effects.
adventuresText.translation: 你准备基本装备、策略及其他手段，以抵御恶劣环境的不利效果。

adventuresText.source: You do not apply the additional Endurance cost of an inclemency to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{Breathe} activity in the segment you approach.
adventuresText.translation: 在你行进到的路段中，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{喘息}活动不计入恶劣环境增加的耐力费用。

adventuresText.source: You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{Circumvent} an inclemency using a path skill if you encounter an inclemency event and if you get a success you reduce the number of segments you are affected by the inclemency by up to 2.
adventuresText.translation: 遇到恶劣环境事件时，你可以使用该路线的一项技能尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{迂回}该恶劣环境。若成功，则将你受到该恶劣环境影响的路段数减少至多 2。

adventuresText.source: (inevitable inclemency) After the party has used @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.yI99AqcBt4JHbgmU]{Approach} four times, a @UUID[.bnV3QJsazElefm8r]{flooding} inclemency begins and lasts for the remainder of the path.
adventuresText.translation: （必然恶劣环境）队伍使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.yI99AqcBt4JHbgmU]{行进}四次后，开始发生@UUID[.bnV3QJsazElefm8r]{洪水}恶劣环境，并持续至走完该路线。

adventuresText.source: An unstable incline threatens to begin an avalanche or landslide. Careful, slow, and tiring treks can avoid the worst scenario.
adventuresText.translation: 不稳定的斜坡随时可能引发雪崩或山体滑坡。谨慎、缓慢而费力地跋涉，可以避免最糟糕的情况。

adventuresText.source: Creatures can choose to ignore the Endurance Cost of a Potential Avalanche when they use journey activities, but if they do the GM makes a @Check[flat|dc:10]. On a failure, an avalanche occurs and all members of the company lose all remaining Endurance and become fatigued.
adventuresText.translation: 生物使用旅行活动时，可以选择忽略潜在雪崩的耐力费用，但若如此，主持人会进行一次 @Check[flat|dc:10]。失败时发生雪崩，所有随行队员失去全部剩余耐力，并陷入疲乏。

adventuresText.source: greater difficult terrain
adventuresText.translation: 高等困难地形

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: Creatures may choose to increase the DC to Survey by 2. If the Survey result is a success, it immediately ends the effects of the inclemency.
adventuresText.translation: 生物可以选择使勘察的DC增加 2。若勘察结果为成功，则立即结束该恶劣环境的效果。

adventuresText.source: A solitary grave beneath an ancient tree with wilting flowers laid atop. The vase that held the flowers sits broken, presumably knocked over by the wind.
adventuresText.translation: 古树下有一座孤坟，坟上放着枯萎的花朵。盛花的花瓶已经破碎，想必是被风吹倒的。

adventuresText.source: Occultism (hard), Religion (standard), Society (very hard)
adventuresText.translation: 神秘（困难）、宗教（标准）、社群（极难）

adventuresText.source: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} (same difficulty and skills as Recall Knowledge), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} the vase (standard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} (very hard)
adventuresText.translation: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法}（难度和技能与回忆知识相同）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{修理}花瓶（标准）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}（极难）

adventuresText.source: Identify Magic to see a lingering spirit requires peace, Repair the vase and place the flowers inside, searching and finding the grave points a special direction, any action that would dig up or disturb the grave (detrimental).
adventuresText.translation: 辨识魔法，发现一个需要安息的徘徊精魂；修理花瓶并将花朵放入其中；搜索并发现坟墓指向一个特别的方向；任何挖掘或扰动坟墓的动作（有害）。

adventuresText.source: The grave sits dormant. If the repercussions are the result of digging up or disturbing the grave, the creature or creatures that performed the actions lose 1 Endurance as the spirit rebukes them.
adventuresText.translation: 坟墓保持沉寂。若后果源于挖掘或扰动坟墓，执行这些动作的一个或多个生物受到精魂的斥责，失去1点耐力。

adventuresText.source: The spirit peacefully manifests and reveals its identity before passing on. Before departing, it reveals a forgotten route it traveled in life, adding a hidden segment to the path.
adventuresText.translation: 精魂平静地显现，揭示自己的身份后安然离去。离去之前，它揭示了自己生前行走过的一条被遗忘的道路，为此路线增加一个隐藏路段。

adventuresText.source: Friendly creatures offer a meal or their leftovers.
adventuresText.translation: 友善的生物提供一餐饭食或剩余食物。

adventuresText.source: Each party member gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half their level.
adventuresText.translation: 每位队伍成员获得等于自身等级一半的临时生命值。

adventuresText.source: 1 alchemical food for each party member.
adventuresText.translation: 每位队伍成员获得 1 份炼金食物。

adventuresText.source: An oasis in an otherwise harsh environment.
adventuresText.translation: 严酷环境中的一处绿洲。

adventuresText.source: Each party member regains all Endurance and all active inclemencies ends.
adventuresText.translation: 每位队员恢复全部耐力，且所有生效中的恶劣环境结束。

adventuresText.source: 1 common consumable for each party member of their choice, 1 common permanent non-magical item for each party member of their choice that is 1 Bulk or lighter, and 1 magical item (determined by the GM).
adventuresText.translation: 每位队员自选 1 件普通消耗品，每位队员自选 1 件负载不超过 1 的普通永久非魔法物品，以及 1 件魔法物品（由主持人决定）。

adventuresText.source: (danger) Trigger The party interacts with the Hidden Trove; Effect The next time the adventurers @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{Survey}, 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-npc-core.Actor.FBq4bqtKUBpJUCMU]{bandits} attempt to ambush the party.
adventuresText.translation: （险情）触发 队伍与隐藏宝藏互动；效果 冒险者下次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{勘察}时，4 名@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-npc-core.Actor.FBq4bqtKUBpJUCMU]{劫匪}尝试伏击队伍。

adventuresText.source: A bountiful field or forest presents itself, with copious amounts to provide a bit of reprieve.
adventuresText.translation: 一片丰饶的田野或森林出现在眼前，充足的物产能让你们稍得喘息。

adventuresText.source: Each party member regains 1 Endurance and Hit Points equal to twice the path’s level.
adventuresText.translation: 每位队员恢复 1 耐力，以及等于路线等级两倍的生命值。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: This shrine or monument to a benevolent god provides a blessing to travelers.
adventuresText.translation: 这座献给仁善神祇的神龛或纪念碑，会为旅人提供祝福。

adventuresText.source: If the party has a member who worships the deity or a party member performs an act of worship while at the shrine, increase the number of respite segments by 2.
adventuresText.translation: 若队伍中有成员信奉该神祇，或有队员在神龛处进行敬拜，休憩路段数增加 2。

adventuresText.source: Each party member gains the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{bless} for the next danger they encounter.
adventuresText.translation: 在下一次遇到的险情中，每位队员都获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{祝福术}的效果。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: You keep in charge of appearances and attitude, both of which wear on a journey.
adventuresText.translation: 你负责维持仪表与态度，两者都会在旅途中受到影响。

adventuresText.source: Attempt a Diplomacy check when you Approach the segment, as you approach non-violently. If you encounter a danger event that contains creatures that could be negotiated with (subject to GM discretion), you use your Diplomacy check for initiative and if your result is equal to or greater than the Will DC of a creature in the danger event, they are non-hostile to you until you take a hostile action or they succeed at a Sense Motive check to see you as an enemy.
adventuresText.translation: 行进到该路段时，进行一次交涉检定，以和平方式接近。如果遇到的险情事件包含能够协商的生物（由主持人裁定），你使用该交涉检定作为先攻。如果检定结果等于或超过险情事件中某个生物的意志DC，则该生物不会敌视你，直到你采取敌对行动，或它成功通过察言观色检定，发现你是敌人。

adventuresText.source: You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{Circumvent} using Diplomacy if you encounter a danger event that contains creatures that could be negotiated with (subject to GM discretion), using the result of your Diplomacy check when you approach for your result. The DC is typically a hard DC of the path’s level or the highest Will DC among the creatures in the danger, whichever is higher.
adventuresText.translation: 如果遇到的险情事件包含能够协商的生物（由主持人裁定），你可以用交涉尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{迂回}，采用行进时的交涉检定结果。其DC通常取路线等级对应的困难DC，或险情中所有生物的最高意志DC，以较高者为准。

adventuresText.source: You use your surroundings to keep you and your party hidden.
adventuresText.translation: 你利用周围环境隐藏自己和队伍。

adventuresText.source: Attempt a Stealth check when you Approach the segment, attempting to be stealthy. If you encounter a danger event that contains creatures you could avoid the notice of (subject to GM discretion), you use your Stealth check for initiative and if your result is equal to or greater than the Perception DC of a creature in the danger event, that creature cannot take reactions against you until you take a hostile action during the danger.
adventuresText.translation: 你在行进该路段时尝试一次隐秘检定，力求隐蔽行动。如果遭遇的险情事件包含你有可能避开其注意的生物（由 GM 裁定），便以该隐秘检定作为先攻；如果结果达到或超过险情事件中某个生物的察觉 DC，该生物在你于此次险情中采取敌对动作之前，无法对你使用反应。

adventuresText.source: You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{Circumvent} using Stealth if you encounter a danger event that contains creatures you could avoid the notice of (subject to GM discretion), using the result of your Stealth check when you approach for your result. The DC is typically a hard DC of the path’s level or the highest Perception DC among the creatures in the danger, whichever is higher.
adventuresText.translation: 如果遭遇的险情事件包含你有可能避开其注意的生物（由 GM 裁定），你可以使用隐秘尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{迂回}，采用行进时所作的隐秘检定结果。DC 通常取路线等级的困难 DC，或险情中生物的最高察觉 DC，两者取较高值。

adventuresText.source: A grove of pale flowers expands into a seemingly perfect circle. The flowers have a faint glow to them on closer inspection. At night, the flowers obviously glow and nearby insects chirp in an almost musical fashion.
adventuresText.translation: 一片浅色花丛蔓延成一个看似完美的圆。仔细观察便能发现花朵散发着微光。夜间，花朵的光芒清晰可见，附近昆虫的鸣声宛如音乐。

adventuresText.source: Flower Lore (easy), Nature (standard), Society (hard)
adventuresText.translation: 花卉学识（简单）、自然（标准）、社群（困难）

adventuresText.source: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} (easy; must be able to communicate with plants), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform} (standard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} (very hard)
adventuresText.translation: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}（简单；必须能够与植物交流）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{演出}（标准）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{翻滚}（极难）

adventuresText.source: Make an Impression, Perform a dance, Tumble Through the flowers, any action that would result in plucking a flower (detrimental)
adventuresText.translation: 建立印象、以舞蹈进行演出、翻滚穿过花丛、任何会摘下花朵的动作（有害）

adventuresText.source: The flowers close and remain dormant for the remainder of the journey. If the repercussions are the result of plucking a flower, the flowers erupt in pollen before closing, causing all animals and plants on the current path to treat their attitude towards the party as one step worse until they completely remove the pollen (@Check[flat|dc:15] as part of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{Breathe} activity).
adventuresText.translation: 花朵闭合，并在本次旅程余下的时间内保持休眠。如果不良后果由摘花引发，花朵会在闭合前喷出花粉，使当前路线上的所有动物与植物对队伍的态度均恶化一级，直到队伍彻底清除花粉（作为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{喘息}活动的一部分，进行 @Check[flat|dc:15]）。

adventuresText.source: The flowers bloom and release restorative pollen throughout the grove. The grove becomes a @UUID[.JT8mFID0LcFcYiOA]{Restorative Grove} abundance.
adventuresText.translation: 花朵绽放，向整片林地释放具有恢复作用的花粉。此地变为@UUID[.JT8mFID0LcFcYiOA]{恢复林地}丰饶。

adventuresText.source: A pile of treasure, ripe for the taking.
adventuresText.translation: 一堆唾手可得的宝藏。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: 1 common consumable for each party member of their choice, 1 common permanent non-magical item for each party member of their choice that is 1 Bulk or lighter, and 1 magical item (determined by the GM).
adventuresText.translation: 每位队员自选 1 件普通消耗品，每位队员自选 1 件负载不超过 1 的普通永久非魔法物品，以及 1 件魔法物品（由主持人决定）。

adventuresText.source: The grove restores the heroes.
adventuresText.translation: 这片林地让英雄们恢复元气。

adventuresText.source: Each party member regains 1 Endurance, regains all of its Hit Points, and gains the effects of a neutralize poison and remove disease spells of a rank equal to half the path’s level rounded up.
adventuresText.translation: 每位队伍成员恢复 1 点耐力和全部生命值，并获得中和毒性和移除疾病法术的效果，法术环阶等于路线等级的一半，向上取整。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

MHK2o3QaXYYpyK64.name: 移动沙丘 Shifting Desert Dunes

adventuresText.source: Winds constantly reshape the dunes, erasing landmarks and creating new paths.
adventuresText.translation: 风不断重塑沙丘，抹去地标并创造新的道路。

adventuresText.source: If an inclemency event is in effect when a disorientation occurs, the combination changes one of its values to another appropriate value.
adventuresText.translation: 如果迷向发生时有恶劣环境事件正在生效，方向组合中的一个值会变成另一个合适的值。

adventuresText.source: Heat Exhaustion
adventuresText.translation: 热衰竭 Heat Exhaustion

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, and each member of the company must attempt a Fortitude save against a standard DC of the path’s level, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{fatigued} on a failure
adventuresText.translation: 同阶段 1，且全队每位成员都必须尝试一次强韧豁免，DC 等于路线等级的标准 DC，失败时陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}

adventuresText.source: As stage 2, except the party experiences an inclemency event from the path (subject to GM discretion).
adventuresText.translation: 同阶段 2，但队伍还会遭遇路线上的一项恶劣环境事件（由 GM 裁定）。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: Visual Perception checks suffer a –2 circumstance penalty. All creatures within the fog are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{concealed} to creatures that are more than 5 feet from them, and other creatures are also concealed from them.
adventuresText.translation: 视觉察觉检定承受 –2 环境减值。雾中的所有生物对于距离自己超过 5 尺的生物均处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，其他生物对它们也同样隐蔽。

adventuresText.source: Checks to Survey using Perception suffer a –2 circumstance penalty.
adventuresText.translation: 使用察觉进行勘察的检定承受 –2 环境减值。

adventuresText.source: During a danger, discovery, or navigation, the GM makes a @Check[flat|dc:5] each round or each interval of exploration or journey activities. If the check is a failure, the effect of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.x7SPrsRxGb2Vy2nu]{earthquake} happen within the area of the danger, discovery, or navigation.
adventuresText.translation: 在险情、发现或导航期间，GM 每轮，或每个探索活动或旅行活动的时间间隔，进行一次 @Check[flat|dc:5]。如果检定失败，险情、发现或导航所在区域内便发生@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.x7SPrsRxGb2Vy2nu]{地震术}的效果。

adventuresText.source: difficult terrain. Creatures must use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} to move against an Athletics DC of the path’s level unless they have a fly Speed.
adventuresText.translation: 困难地形。除非拥有飞行速度，否则生物必须使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{攀爬}移动，运动 DC 等于路线等级对应的 DC。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: Checks to Survey using Acrobatics or Athletics suffer a –2 circumstance penalty.
adventuresText.translation: 使用特技或运动进行勘察的检定承受 –2 环境减值。

adventuresText.source: You act as a scout to allow for more time to recover.
adventuresText.translation: 你担任侦察员，为队伍争取更多恢复时间。

adventuresText.source: You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your initiative rolls for dangers you were aware of as a result of a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{Survey}.
adventuresText.translation: 对于因成功@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{勘察}而知晓的险情，你的先攻检定获得 +4 环境加值。

adventuresText.source: You grant yourself and the company a +2 circumstance bonus on your next check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{Camp} or Survey in the segment you approach.
adventuresText.translation: 你使自己与随行队伍在所行进到的路段中，下一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{扎营}或勘察检定获得 +2 环境加值。

adventuresText.source: None; if the rain lasts for more than 3 segments, difficult terrain
adventuresText.translation: 无；若降雨持续超过 3 个路段，则为困难地形

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: None; if the rain lasts for more than 3 segments, checks to Survey using Survival suffer a –2 circumstance penalty.
adventuresText.translation: 无；若降雨持续超过 3 个路段，使用生存进行勘察的检定承受 –2 环境减值。

adventuresText.source: As @UUID[.jscfgtTBrFgxOsTQ]{Wind (Strong)}, but even creatures on the ground or in water suffer. Creatures on the ground must succeed on an Athletics check to move. On a critical failure, the creature is knocked back 20 feet and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}. Creatures that are swimming must make an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}, or they are knocked back 20 feet and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 round. The DC of the Athletics checks is equal to a hard DC of the path’s level.
adventuresText.translation: 同@UUID[.jscfgtTBrFgxOsTQ]{风（强烈）}，但连地面或水中的生物也会受到影响。地面上的生物必须在运动检定中成功才能移动。大失败时，该生物被击退20尺并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。游泳中的生物必须进行运动检定来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{游泳}，否则会被击退20尺，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}1轮。这些运动检定的DC等于此路线等级的困难DC。

adventuresText.source: Actions or activities with the auditory or linguistic trait that require a creature to hear or understand them must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5], or the action is unheard over the storm.
adventuresText.translation: 具有听觉或语言特征、需要生物听见或理解的动作或活动，必须通过一次@Check[flat|dc:5]，否则其声音会被风暴淹没。

adventuresText.source: None.
adventuresText.translation: 无。

adventuresText.source: You cover your tracks when fleeing.
adventuresText.translation: 你在逃离时掩盖踪迹。

adventuresText.source: When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.fQ2an1a1ga8U7vrc]{Retreat} from a danger in the segment, reduce your Endurance cost to Retreat by 1.
adventuresText.translation: 从该路段的险情@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.fQ2an1a1ga8U7vrc]{撤退}时，你撤退的耐力费用减少1。

adventuresText.source: When you Retreat from a danger in the segment, you reduce the Endurance cost to Retreat for all allies by 1.
adventuresText.translation: 从该路段的险情撤退时，你使所有盟友撤退的耐力费用减少1。

adventuresText.source: Pale lights drift across the marsh, tempting travelers away from the true path.
adventuresText.translation: 苍白的光点飘荡在沼泽上，诱使旅人偏离正确道路。

adventuresText.source: Religion (standard)
adventuresText.translation: 宗教（标准）

adventuresText.source: Ghost Lights
adventuresText.translation: 鬼火 Ghost Lights

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, except each member of the company must attempt a Will save against a standard DC of the path’s level, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} or increasing their frightened value by 1 on a failure. This frightened condition remains until the navigation event is resolved or the party retreats.
adventuresText.translation: 同第 1 阶段，但每位随行队员必须进行一次意志豁免，对抗路线等级对应的标准DC，失败时陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}，或使其惊惧值增加 1。该惊惧状态持续至导航事件解决或队伍撤退。

adventuresText.source: When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{Survey}, you can increase the Endurance cost by 1 to adjust your course to account for the wind. If the check is successful, you end the inclemency’s effects and instead gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KcLVELhCUcKXxiKE]{tailwind} for the remaining duration of the inclemency.
adventuresText.translation: 你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{勘察}时，可以将耐力费用增加1，以调整路线适应风向。若检定成功，此恶劣环境的效果结束，改为在其剩余持续时间内获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KcLVELhCUcKXxiKE]{顺风奔行}的效果。

adventuresText.source: Flying in wind is difficult terrain.
adventuresText.translation: 在风中飞行视为困难地形。

adventuresText.source: The range of scent is halved, and auditory Perception checks suffer a –2 circumstance penalty.
adventuresText.translation: 嗅觉范围减半，听觉察觉检定承受–2环境减值。

adventuresText.source: Checks to Survey using Sailing Lore gain a +2 circumstance bonus.
adventuresText.translation: 使用航海学识进行勘察的检定获得+2环境加值。

adventuresText.source: Snow buries old trails while blizzards obscure distant landmarks.
adventuresText.translation: 积雪掩埋了旧日小径，暴风雪遮蔽了远处的地标。

adventuresText.source: Acrobatics (hard)
adventuresText.translation: 特技（困难）

adventuresText.source: Bitter Cold
adventuresText.translation: 凛冽严寒 Bitter Cold

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, except Stealth checks to Navigate take a –2 circumstance penalty
adventuresText.translation: 同第 1 阶段，但用于导航的隐秘检定承受 –2 环境减值

adventuresText.source: As stage 2, except the party experiences an inclemency event (subject to GM discretion).
adventuresText.translation: 同第 2 阶段，但队伍遭遇一个恶劣环境事件（由主持人裁定）。

adventuresText.source: Another plane is converging on the existence of this one, creating an unthinkable and ever shifting environment.
adventuresText.translation: 另一个位面正与此位面的存在交汇，形成不可思议、不断变动的环境。

adventuresText.source: Planar Lore (standard), a skill with the Recall Knowledge action for the appropriate plane
adventuresText.translation: 位面学识（标准）、可用于对相应位面进行回忆知识动作的技能

adventuresText.source: Spatial Drift
adventuresText.translation: 空间漂移 Spatial Drift

adventuresText.source: 2 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 2 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, and each Navigate check takes a –2 circumstance penalty
adventuresText.translation: 同第 1 阶段，且每次导航检定承受 –2 环境减值

adventuresText.source: As stage 2, except the party experiences a danger event with an appropriate planar creature (subject to GM discretion).
adventuresText.translation: 同第 2 阶段，但队伍遭遇一个涉及适当位面生物的险情事件（由主持人裁定）。

YKsUBKeurF8X1BHB.name: 虚假楼层 False Step Floor

adventuresText.source: A heat wave saps the strength for travel and can sometimes cause perceptions to blur.
adventuresText.translation: 热浪消磨旅人的体力，有时还会使感知变得模糊。

adventuresText.source: Without the proper protection from the heat, creatures traveling are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1}.
adventuresText.translation: 没有适当的防暑措施时，旅行中的生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}状态。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: None; if the heat lasts for more than 2 segments, creatures traveling are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{dazzled}.
adventuresText.translation: 无；若炎热持续超过 2 个路段，旅行中的生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}状态。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

a0nDLHkHt2J5GFk6.name: 古水晶龙 Ancient Crystal Dragon

adventuresText.source: difficult terrain
adventuresText.translation: 困难地形

adventuresText.source: Actions or activities with the auditory or linguistic trait that require a creature to hear or understand them must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5], or the action is unheard over the storm.
adventuresText.translation: 具有听觉或语言特征、且需要生物听见或理解的动作或活动，必须成功通过一次 @Check[flat|dc:5]，否则其声音会被风暴淹没而无法听见。

adventuresText.source: Checks to Survey using Perception or Survival suffer a –2 circumstance penalty.
adventuresText.translation: 使用察觉或生存进行勘察的检定承受 –2 环境减值。

adventuresText.source: The land is flooded and difficult to travel.
adventuresText.translation: 大地被洪水淹没，难以通行。

adventuresText.source: Creatures may ignore the Endurance Cost of Flooding if creatures have a proper vehicle and they do not need to Swim.
adventuresText.translation: 如果生物有合适的载具，而且不需要游泳，就可以忽略洪水的耐力费用。

adventuresText.source: greater difficult terrain; If the flooding lasts for more than 2 segments, creatures must @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}.
adventuresText.translation: 高等困难地形；若洪水持续超过 2 个路段，生物就必须@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{游泳}。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: You encourage your party to continue on, even in severe hardship.
adventuresText.translation: 你鼓励队伍继续前进，即使身陷艰难险境也不放弃。

adventuresText.source: The first time you suffer a disorientation during a navigation, you recover 1 Endurance.
adventuresText.translation: 你在导航事件中首次遭受迷向时，恢复 1 耐力。

adventuresText.source: The first time the company suffers a disorientation, each other member of the company recovers 1 Endurance.
adventuresText.translation: 随行队伍首次遭受迷向时，其他每位随行队员恢复 1 耐力。

dIdfFbvaVOCYb9OV.name: 沙下之物 The Thing Beneath the Sands

adventuresText.source: (secret danger) Trigger The party fails a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{Survey} while experiencing a @UUID[.V7Mzzq6pJo3RGlMH]{Wind} inclemency or suffers the highest stage of Disorientation during @UUID[.MHK2o3QaXYYpyK64]{Shifting Desert Dunes}; Effect The disturbance awakens part of an enormous creature sleeping beneath the fen. The party encounters a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-2.Actor.O9LzsedLTUVFtOix]{black scorpion}.
adventuresText.translation: （隐秘险情）触发 队伍在遭遇@UUID[.V7Mzzq6pJo3RGlMH]{风}恶劣环境时，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KAI1cIP3cAOTl74c]{勘察}失败，或在@UUID[.MHK2o3QaXYYpyK64]{移动沙丘}期间遭受最高阶段的迷向；效果 扰动唤醒了沉睡在沼泽下方的某个巨型生物的一部分。队伍遭遇一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-2.Actor.O9LzsedLTUVFtOix]{黑蝎}。

exHESEhoYDxaOojz.name: 成年低语龙 Adult Whisper Dragon

iPdYZsODDnmvWxqu.name: 旅行 Journey
iPdYZsODDnmvWxqu.text:
本日志收录@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-journals.JournalEntry.wKHOSd6WYx3q5L0A.JournalEntryPage.eV3Z4W8326Qdyht0]{旅行系统}的示例事件与行进增益。示例路线位于《冒险扩展》日志中，紧随@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-journals.JournalEntry.wKHOSd6WYx3q5L0A.JournalEntryPage.DoZkYNtBgt9qWFOJ]{路线与事件范例}之后。

阅读路线条目的方法见@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-journals.JournalEntry.wKHOSd6WYx3q5L0A.JournalEntryPage.RUApaQsH9CwomBUH]{规划旅程}；阅读各类事件条目的方法见@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-journals.JournalEntry.wKHOSd6WYx3q5L0A.JournalEntryPage.wEU33reFF9oFHwJO]{事件}；行进增益的运用方式见@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-journals.JournalEntry.wKHOSd6WYx3q5L0A.JournalEntryPage.dBKEG9kOyRVtu8Kq]{旅行中的行进方案}。

adventuresText.source: You prepare rations and foraged food in order to feed your party.
adventuresText.translation: 你准备口粮和采集到的食物，为队伍提供餐食。

adventuresText.source: You gain a consumable of the path’s level or lower during an abundance event, or an additional consumable if the abundance already provided a consumable. This consumable is usually an alchemical food, though it can be another type (subject to GM discretion). These bonus items have the infused trait and last until the end of the journey.
adventuresText.translation: 发生丰饶事件时，你获得一件等级不高于路线等级的消耗品；若该丰饶事件本就提供消耗品，则额外获得一件。这种消耗品通常是炼金食品，但也可以是其他类型（由主持人裁定）。这些额外物品具有灌注特征，并持续至旅程结束。

adventuresText.source: You grant a consumable of the path’s level or lower during an abundance event to each of your other party members, or an additional consumable if the abundance already provided a consumable. This consumable is usually an alchemical food, though it can be another type (subject to GM discretion). These bonus items have the infused trait and until the end of the journey.
adventuresText.translation: 发生丰饶事件时，你给予其他每位队员一件等级不高于路线等级的消耗品；若该丰饶事件本就提供消耗品，则额外给予一件。这种消耗品通常是炼金食品，但也可以是其他类型（由主持人裁定）。这些额外物品具有灌注特征，并持续至旅程结束。

adventuresText.source: You are adept at using maps and landmarks to keep on the path.
adventuresText.translation: 你善于借助地图与地标，沿正确路线前进。

adventuresText.source: If you roll a critical failure on a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.CIJuYb1VmjUL973c]{Navigate}, you get a failure instead.
adventuresText.translation: 若你的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.CIJuYb1VmjUL973c]{导航}检定大失败，则改为失败。

adventuresText.source: If you roll a success on a check to Navigate, you get a critical success instead.
adventuresText.translation: 若你的导航检定成功，则改为大成功。

adventuresText.source: As @UUID[.V7Mzzq6pJo3RGlMH]{Wind}, but using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly} requires a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Qf1ylAbdVi1rkc8M]{Maneuver in Flight} against a hard DC of the path’s level. On a critical failure, flying creatures are moved 20 feet in a non-vertical direction of the GM’s choosing.
adventuresText.translation: 同@UUID[.V7Mzzq6pJo3RGlMH]{风}，但使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{飞行}需要进行一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Qf1ylAbdVi1rkc8M]{空中机动}，对抗此路线等级的困难DC。大失败时，飞行中的生物沿游戏主持人选择的一个非垂直方向移动20尺。

adventuresText.source: As Wind, but the penalty increases to –3.
adventuresText.translation: 同风，但减值增加至–3。

adventuresText.source: None.
adventuresText.translation: 无。

adventuresText.source: A stag of shining white stands at a distance. It cautiously stands, periodically looking toward the wilderness behind it before returning its attention to you.
adventuresText.translation: 一头通体亮白的雄鹿站在远处。它警惕地驻足，不时望向身后的荒野，随后又将注意力转回你身上。

adventuresText.source: The hart flees after two failed attempts to Discover. It may be possible to encounter the hart again during a journey when it flees in this way.
adventuresText.translation: 探究尝试失败两次后，白鹿就会逃走。如果它以这种方式逃走，队伍可能在旅行中再次遇见它。

adventuresText.source: Nature (standard), Society (very hard), Animal Lore (standard)
adventuresText.translation: 自然（标准）、社群（极难）、动物学识（标准）

adventuresText.source: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} (hard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} (very hard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} (standard), any attack (standard).
adventuresText.translation: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{察言观色}（困难）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{指挥动物}（极难）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{追踪}（标准）、任意攻击（标准）。

adventuresText.source: Sense Motive to understand the hart’s intentions, Command an Animal to ask for its aid, Track to follow it, any attack action (detrimental).
adventuresText.translation: 用察言观色理解白鹿的意图；用指挥动物请求其协助；用追踪跟随它；任意攻击动作（有害）。

adventuresText.source: The hart flees. If the repercussions are the result of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} or another attempt to harm the hart, the nearby wildlife retaliates against the party, starting an encounter.
adventuresText.translation: 白鹿逃走。若后果源于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{打击}或其他试图伤害白鹿的行为，附近的野生动物会报复队伍，并开始一场遭遇。

adventuresText.source: The hart accepts the party’s presence and leads them to a nearby waterfall and cave before disappearing into the wilderness. The discovery becomes a @UUID[.70rm3X0PEZcL4yTz]{Majestic Waterfall} abundance.
adventuresText.translation: 白鹿接纳队伍的存在，将他们带到附近的一处瀑布与洞穴，然后消失在荒野中。此发现变为@UUID[.70rm3X0PEZcL4yTz]{壮丽瀑布}丰饶事件。

ktVcSyu47eUOP62t.name: 噬食之门 The Door That Eats

adventuresText.source: A wooden door with a brass knocker, the eyes of which move. The knocker carries the face of a ravenous creature with sharp teeth with a half-eaten being serving as the hammer.
adventuresText.translation: 一扇木门上装着黄铜门环，门环的眼睛会动。门环刻着一张饥肠辘辘、长满利齿的生物面孔，敲锤则是一个被吃掉半边的生物。

adventuresText.source: Crafting (very hard), Planar Lore (standard), Religion (hard), Sense Motive (hard)
adventuresText.translation: 手艺（极难）、位面学识（标准）、宗教（困难）、察言观色（困难）

adventuresText.source: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} on the door (very hard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} the door open (very hard or standard with meat offering), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object} to guess the correct rhythm (very hard, requires a successful Recall Knowledge), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} (very hard, 2 successes required)
adventuresText.translation: 对门使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破拆}（极难），@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{请求}让门打开（极难，或在献上肉食时为标准），使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{手上功夫}猜出正确节奏（极难，需要成功通过回忆知识），@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{开锁}（极难，需要 2 次成功）

adventuresText.source: Force Open (detrimental), successfully Request the door open, feeding the door freshly killed meat, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to knock the correct rhythm, Pick a Lock on the door.
adventuresText.translation: 破拆（有害），成功请求让门打开，给门喂食刚刚杀死的鲜肉，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{交互}敲出正确节奏，对门开锁。

adventuresText.source: The door takes offense and the knocker’s eyes close. If the repercussions are the result of attempting to Force Open the door, it becomes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.h74BX4Iw78gWewa4]{mimic} and immediately triggers Object Lesson reaction from the offending creature, after which an encounter begins.
adventuresText.translation: 门被冒犯，门环的眼睛闭上。如果不良后果是由尝试破拆门导致，它会变成@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.h74BX4Iw78gWewa4]{拟态怪}，并立即由冒犯它的生物触发实物教训反应，随后开始一场遭遇。

adventuresText.source: The satisfied door opens onto a small extradimensional waystation. The door can be used to go to any segment the party has already visited on this path from the current segment. The door may agree to provide further transportation if provided a suitable meal with a successful Request.
adventuresText.translation: 门得到满足，敞开通往一处小型异次元驿站。使用这扇门可以从当前路段前往队伍在这条路线上已到访的任一路段。如果提供一顿合适的餐食并成功请求，门可能同意继续提供运送服务。

adventuresText.source: You come upon a friendly traveling merchant looking to fence goods.
adventuresText.translation: 你遇到了一位友善的行商，正打算销赃。

adventuresText.source: The party may buy and sell items from the merchant as appropriate (subject to GM discretion).
adventuresText.translation: 队伍可以酌情与商人买卖物品（由游戏主持人裁定）。

adventuresText.source: The party gains the results of a successful Survey on an adjacent segment of their choice.
adventuresText.translation: 队伍选择一个相邻路段，获得对此路段勘察成功的结果。

adventuresText.source: None. If this abundance was the result of another resolved event, such as a Discovery, each party member gains a common piece of adventuring gear of a level no higher than half the path's level as a gift.
adventuresText.translation: 无。如果此次丰饶源自另一个已解决事件，例如发现，则每名队员都获赠一件等级不高于此路线等级一半的常见冒险装备。

adventuresText.source: This appears to be a cabin, a tent, an empty cave, or something else similarly abandoned. While not cozy, it provides enough shelter to escape poor weather.
adventuresText.translation: 这里看起来是一间木屋、一顶帐篷、一个空洞穴，或类似的废弃场所。虽然并不舒适，却足以遮蔽风雨，让人躲避恶劣天气。

adventuresText.source: You ignore Endurance Cost from an inclemency to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{Breathe} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{Camp} journey activities.
adventuresText.translation: 你进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{喘息}与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{扎营}旅行活动时，忽略恶劣环境造成的耐力费用。

adventuresText.source: The GM makes a @Check[flat|dc:17]. If the result is a success, the party gains 1 consumable and 1 permanent non-magical item.
adventuresText.translation: 主持人进行一次@Check[flat|dc:17]。若结果成功，队伍获得 1 件消耗品和 1 件非魔法永久物品。

lrWBZ6A13ORJUFc5.name: 纠缠荆棘迷宫 Tangled Briar Maze

adventuresText.source: A dense thicket of twisting briars and overgrown trails makes it nearly impossible to determine the correct route.
adventuresText.translation: 蜿蜒荆棘组成的茂密灌丛与杂草丛生的小径，让人几乎无法辨明正确路线。

adventuresText.source: Lost
adventuresText.translation: 迷路 Lost

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, except attempting to Navigate deals piercing damage equal to the path’s level
adventuresText.translation: 同阶段 1，但尝试导航会造成等于路线等级的穿刺伤害

adventuresText.source: As stage 2, except the party experiences a danger event from the path (subject to GM discretion).
adventuresText.translation: 同阶段 2，但队伍还会遭遇路线上的一项险情事件（由 GM 裁定）。

adventuresText.source: A stone bridge crossing a narrow ravine. Its canyon below resembles a sleeping face, with the slope of the bridge aligning as a nose.
adventuresText.translation: 一座石桥横跨狭窄的峡谷。桥下的峡谷形似一张沉睡的脸，而桥面的斜坡恰好如同其鼻梁。

adventuresText.source: Once the discovery is revealed, the elemental can switch the direction of the bridge with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}.
adventuresText.translation: 一旦揭示此发现，通过一次成功的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{请求}，就能让元素生物改变桥梁的方向。

adventuresText.source: Occultism (standard), an appropriate Terrain Lore (hard)
adventuresText.translation: 神秘（标准）、适当的地形学识（困难）

adventuresText.source: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} (standard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform} (hard), any attack action (very hard).
adventuresText.translation: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行}（标准）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{演出}（困难）、任意攻击动作（极难）。

adventuresText.source: Sneak across the bridge, Perform a lullaby or soothing oration, any attack action targeting the bridge or a loud noise (detrimental).
adventuresText.translation: 潜行过桥；演出摇篮曲或舒缓的演说；以桥梁为目标进行任何攻击动作，或发出巨响（有害）。

adventuresText.source: The bridge stands idle. If the repercussions are the result of harming the bridge or a loud noise, a stone elemental awakens to defend the bridge starting an encounter.
adventuresText.translation: 桥梁静止不动。若后果源于伤害桥梁或发出巨响，一个岩石元素生物就会苏醒，保卫桥梁，并开始一场遭遇。

adventuresText.source: The elemental awakens peacefully and reshapes the bridge to another area. The bridge alters its path to another segment that was previously hidden which is always a peaceful or abundance event.
adventuresText.translation: 元素生物平静地苏醒，重塑桥梁，使其通向另一片区域。桥梁改道，通向一个此前隐藏的路段，其中始终为平静或丰饶事件。

oBAsbsBlqbdFLThw.name: 赛特木乃伊先知 Mummy Prophet of Set

adventuresText.source: Massive vines and shifting vegetation seem to grow across the trail as the party advances.
adventuresText.translation: 队伍前行时，巨大的藤蔓与不断变动的植被仿佛正在小径上蔓延生长。

adventuresText.source: Athletics (standard)
adventuresText.translation: 运动（标准）

adventuresText.source: Encroaching Growth
adventuresText.translation: 蔓生侵占 Encroaching Growth

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, except attempts to Navigate cost 1 additional Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 同第 1 阶段，但尝试导航额外消耗 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 2, except the party experiences a danger event (subject to GM discretion).
adventuresText.translation: 同第 2 阶段，但队伍遭遇一个险情事件（由主持人裁定）。

adventuresText.source: A small hamlet of kind families that welcome the adventurers.
adventuresText.translation: 一座由善良人家组成的小村落，欢迎冒险者到来。

adventuresText.source: The party may @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{Camp} without spending Endurance and the result is an automatic critical success.
adventuresText.translation: 队伍可以不花费耐力进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{扎营}，结果自动为大成功。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: A large statuesque humanoid stands stoically covered in moss. The statue looks near life-like, leaving one to wonder whether it is a statue at all or a petrified creature.
adventuresText.translation: 一个巨大的类人生物形体肃立着，宛如雕像，身上布满苔藓。它近乎栩栩如生，不禁让人怀疑，这究竟是雕像，还是一个被石化的生物。

adventuresText.source: Crafting (hard), Medicine (standard), Mountain Lore (standard), Nature (hard), Society (very hard)
adventuresText.translation: 手艺（困难）、医疗（标准）、山地学识（标准）、自然（困难）、社群（极难）

adventuresText.source: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} (hard), any attack action (standard).
adventuresText.translation: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{治疗伤势}（困难）、任何攻击动作（标准）。

adventuresText.source: Treat Wounds to chip away the exterior stone, casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Pr1ruNTbzGn3H9w5]{stone to flesh} or similar magic to return the petrified creature to life, any attack action (detrimental).
adventuresText.translation: 通过治疗伤势剥去外层石壳、施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Pr1ruNTbzGn3H9w5]{解除石化}或类似魔法，使被石化的生物恢复生命、任何攻击动作（有害）。

adventuresText.source: The party fails to understand the petrification. If the repercussions are the result of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike}, the stone statue awakens as a hostile mindless construct and an encounter begins.
adventuresText.translation: 队伍未能理解石化的情况。如果不良后果由@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{打击}引发，石像会作为一个敌对的无心智构装体苏醒，并开始一次遭遇。

adventuresText.source: The petrification is broken and a grateful giant awakens. The giant is freed and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} towards the party, offering to help the party. The first @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} made of the giant is treated as one degree of success better.
adventuresText.translation: 石化被解除，心怀感激的巨人苏醒。巨人重获自由，对队伍态度@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}，并主动提出帮助队伍。向巨人提出的第一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{请求}，成功程度提高一级。

adventuresText.source: A weathered stone tomb. The tomb marks the resting place of an ancient hero. A worn inscription above its sealed entrance recounts their final deeds, though time has rendered much of it illegible.
adventuresText.translation: 这是一座饱经风霜的石墓，标示着一位古代英雄的安息之所。封闭入口上方磨损的铭文记述了这位英雄最后的事迹，但岁月已让大部分内容难以辨认。

adventuresText.source: A character who already knows the identity and deeds of the buried hero gains a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge and to Discover on the discovery.
adventuresText.translation: 已经知晓墓中英雄身份与事迹的角色，对此发现进行回忆知识与探究的检定获得 +2 环境加值。

adventuresText.source: Religion (hard), Society (standard), Warfare Lore (easy)
adventuresText.translation: 宗教（困难）、社群（标准）、战争学识（简单）

adventuresText.source: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} on the inscription (hard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the tomb (very hard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform} (standard).
adventuresText.translation: 对铭文@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{解译文书}（困难）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破拆}陵墓（极难）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{演出}（标准）。

adventuresText.source: Decipher Writing to read the heroes prayer, Force Open on the tomb (detrimental), Perform an oration or similar honor to the hero.
adventuresText.translation: 解译文书以读出英雄的祷文、破拆陵墓（会造成不利后果）、演出一场致辞或以类似方式向英雄致敬。

adventuresText.source: The party misinterprets the monument. If the repercussions are the result of a Force Open, the hero’s spirit rises to defend its resting place, starting an encounter.
adventuresText.translation: 队伍误解了这座纪念碑。若这一后果源自破拆，英雄的精魂将现身保卫其安息之地，开始一场遭遇。

adventuresText.source: The hero’s spirit briefly manifests and blesses those who remembered their deeds. The tomb becomes a @UUID[.EyODCVNqf0vbLc6P]{Blessed Shrine} abundance.
adventuresText.translation: 英雄的精魂短暂显现，为铭记其事迹的人赐福。这座陵墓成为@UUID[.EyODCVNqf0vbLc6P]{赐福神龛}丰饶事件。

adventuresText.source: You track a known creature.
adventuresText.translation: 你追踪一个已知的生物。

adventuresText.source: Attempt a Survival check when you Approach the segment, discovering appropriate tracks if your result is successful. The GM determines the DCs for such checks, depending on the freshness of the trail, the weather, the type of ground, and the creatures on the path.
adventuresText.translation: 你在行进该路段时尝试一次生存检定；成功便发现相应的踪迹。GM 根据踪迹的新旧、天气、地面类型和路线上的生物，决定这类检定的 DC。

adventuresText.source: You automatically determine the next adjacent segment a creature moved to if you successfully discover tracks in the segment you approach.
adventuresText.translation: 如果你在此次行进的路段成功发现踪迹，就会自动确定该生物接下来进入了哪个相邻路段。

uUyZiG3OET2vPyfK.name: 沼蜍人侦查队 Boggard Scouting Party

adventuresText.source: 1 boggard scouting party.
adventuresText.translation: 1 支沼蜍人侦查队。

adventuresText.source: This appears to be an adventurer’s gear that was left behind, either as a result of a hasty retreat or less fortunate circumstances.
adventuresText.translation: 这些似乎是冒险者留下的装备，可能遗落于仓促撤退之际，也可能意味着更不幸的遭遇。

adventuresText.source: None
adventuresText.translation: 无

adventuresText.source: 1 permanent magic item, an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.2req0jGaxz8hScdB]{adventurer’s pack}, and a common or uncommon weapon
adventuresText.translation: 1 件永久魔法物品、一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.2req0jGaxz8hScdB]{冒险装备包}，以及一件普通或罕见武器

adventuresText.source: You keep gear in shape and scrounge together supplies.
adventuresText.translation: 你维护装备，并搜集补给。

adventuresText.source: After a danger, the first time you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{Breathe} activity to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q4kdWVOf2ztIBFg1]{Identify Alchemy}, you reduce the Endurance cost by 1.
adventuresText.translation: 险情过后，你首次使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.OxEhepyZ6dU4W6B4]{喘息}活动进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{修理}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q4kdWVOf2ztIBFg1]{辨识炼金术}时，将耐力消耗降低 1。

adventuresText.source: You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{Circumvent} using Crafting if you encounter a danger event against creatures or hazards with the construct or mechanical traits. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{Camp} in the segment you approach, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} downtime activity.
adventuresText.translation: 如果遇到的险情事件涉及具有构装体或机械特征的生物或危险，你可以使用手艺尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.rddqPIKA1s7vTMHE]{迂回}。如果你在此次行进的路段@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hbNCfPtKIwugvyPw]{扎营}，便可以使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{制作}休整活动。

adventuresText.source: Invisible paths weave between ancient trees as a breach from the First World creates chaos ahead.
adventuresText.translation: 来自第一世界的裂隙让前路陷入混乱，无形的小径交织于古树之间。

adventuresText.source: Diplomacy (standard), Fey Lore (standard), Nature (hard)
adventuresText.translation: 交涉（标准）、精类学识（标准）、自然（困难）

adventuresText.source: Breach Glamour
adventuresText.translation: 裂隙幻魅 Breach Glamour

adventuresText.source: 1 Endurance
adventuresText.translation: 1 耐力

adventuresText.source: As stage 1, except the party cannot use Survival to Navigate
adventuresText.translation: 同第 1 阶段，但队伍不能使用生存进行导航

adventuresText.source: As stage 2, except the party experiences a danger or discovery event that involves a fey (subject to GM discretion).
adventuresText.translation: 同第 2 阶段，但队伍遭遇一个涉及精类的险情或发现事件（由主持人裁定）。

vyBCYU57E9p0QZ3L.name: 破裂的交汇 The Broken Conjunction

adventuresText.source: (inevitable navigation) The party floats into the air, reversing gravity, so that they land on islands in the air forming a step stool to mechanical doors, preventing any segment travel forward until the navigation is resolved. This functions as a @UUID[.435dYpxi1RqyiXQ1]{Clockwork Corridors} navigation. Resolving it opens two routes: the normal segments ahead and a hidden segment containing a @UUID[.EyODCVNqf0vbLc6P]{Blessed Shrine} abundance.
adventuresText.translation: （必然导航）重力逆转，队伍浮向空中，落在一连串宛如阶梯般通向机械门的浮空岛屿上；解决导航之前，无法前往任何后续路段。此事件如同@UUID[.435dYpxi1RqyiXQ1]{发条回廊}导航。解决后会开启两条路线：前方的正常路段，以及一个包含@UUID[.EyODCVNqf0vbLc6P]{赐福神龛}丰饶的隐藏路段。

adventuresText.source: A crater with a small black metallic dodecahedron. The object emits a faint hum when living creatures approach, while unfamiliar symbols periodically flicker across its surface.
adventuresText.translation: 陨坑中有一个黑色金属小十二面体。活物接近时，它会发出轻微的嗡鸣，不熟悉的符号不时在表面闪烁。

adventuresText.source: Arcana (hard), Astrology Lore (easy), Crafting (standard), Occultism (hard)
adventuresText.translation: 奥秘（困难）、占星学识（简单）、手艺（标准）、神秘（困难）

adventuresText.source: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} (very hard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q4kdWVOf2ztIBFg1]{Identify Alchemy} (standard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} (same difficulty and skills as Recall Knowledge), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} (very hard), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} (very hard)
adventuresText.translation: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{解除装置}（极难）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q4kdWVOf2ztIBFg1]{辨识炼金术}（标准）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法}（难度和技能与回忆知识相同）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{修理}（极难）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{移位}（极难）

adventuresText.source: Disable a Device to see the glyph pattern order, any action that would attempt to damage the object (detrimental), Reposition it upside down (success resolves the danger, failure is detrimental)
adventuresText.translation: 解除装置以查看符文图案的顺序，任何试图损坏物体的动作（有害），用移位将它倒置（成功则解决险情，失败则有害）

adventuresText.source: The dodecahedron deals 1d4 force damage per path level to all creatures in a 30-foot emanation with a basic Reflex save, which always includes the creature that critically failed its Discover check. Creatures are immediately pushed to the edge of the emanation and cannot move closer to it for the remainder of the journey. If the repercussions are the result of a detrimental action, it creates an inclemency appropriate for the path.
adventuresText.translation: 十二面体对 30 尺弥漫内的所有生物造成每路线等级 1d4 力场伤害，可进行基础反射豁免；探究检定大失败的生物始终包含在内。生物立即被推至弥漫边缘，且在此次旅行的余下时间内无法靠近它。如果不良后果是由有害动作导致，它还会创造一种适合该路线的恶劣环境。

adventuresText.source: The object unfolds into an ancient celestial instrument capable of predicting planar and astronomical phenomena. The creature that successfully used Discover gains the effects of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{augury} spell, but the subject is always related to the current journey.
adventuresText.translation: 物体展开，成为一台古老的天体仪器，能够预测位面与天文现象。成功使用探究的生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{卜筮术}法术的效果，但主题始终与当前旅行相关。

adventuresText.source: [[/r 1d3]] sand worms.

0Xzg4xhLvy2d55c9.name: 惊吓 Scares
0Xzg4xhLvy2d55c9.text:
身处恐惧区域时，你可能触发惊吓，即以恐怖题材为灵感的特殊状况。触发惊吓时，掷一枚 d20 并查询下表，决定惊吓的效果。触发一次惊吓后，你在 1 分钟内无法再次触发惊吓；但恐惧值超过 5 而触发的惊吓不受此限，这类惊吓可在任何时候发生，也不会限制其他惊吓的触发。

惊吓通常不会影响敌方生物，但可能影响 NPC 或其他不受恐惧区域欢迎的生物。惊吓的范围通常等同于恐惧区域；如果恐惧区域很大，则不超过边长 120 尺的正方形。如果惊吓列出了持续时间，便持续该时长；否则会无限持续，或直到其效果被消除（例如持续伤害或恶心状态）。如果所有队伍成员都将恐惧值降至 1，或所有队伍成员都已离开恐惧区域，所有仍在生效的惊吓效果立即结束。

[[/r d20]] 结果

效果

1

不自然的雾气弥漫区域，提供隐蔽。这种隐蔽只影响具有恐惧值的生物。区域内生物的基于视觉的察觉检定承受等于其恐惧值的状态减值。此效果持续 10 分钟。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.1b4uRx0H5SGlX6V8]{效果：惊吓（诡异迷雾）}

2

恶臭袭来，或突发病痛。区域内生物陷入恶心，状态值等于惊吓发生时的恐惧值。此效果的 DC 等于队伍等级的标准 DC。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.EqULNjIBPqqBnoZJ]{效果：惊吓（骤发恶心）}

3

区域内所有门、通道及类似出入口立即关闭或被堵塞，将位于障碍物所在位置的生物推至最近的可用空间（由 GM 裁定）。尝试穿过这些门或通道，需要通过运动检定进行破拆，或通过贼活检定解除装置，DC 等于队伍等级的标准 DC。区域内生物为穿越这些障碍所作的运动和贼活检定，承受等于其恐惧值的状态减值。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.tAeym6KksCK7eoaZ]{效果：惊吓（通路封闭）}

4

寒意蔓延，空气骤然变得冰冷刺骨。恐惧区域内生物获得等于其等级一半乘以恐惧值（最小 1）的寒冷和灵魂伤害弱点。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KCd8WWPK1XPtOHvI]{效果：惊吓（寒意侵袭）}

5

黑暗逼近。区域内所有非魔法光源立即熄灭，所有魔法光源的范围减半。区域内生物以隐蔽或处于藏匿状态的生物为目标时，所需纯骰检定的 DC 增加等于其恐惧值的数值。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.mrwaTGceDqFfZTVO]{效果：惊吓（黑暗逼近）}

6

诡异的寂静笼罩此地。区域内生物的基于听觉的察觉检定和隐秘检定，承受等于其恐惧值的状态减值。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.mKhuRcJFW7iXUsEV]{效果：惊吓（诡异寂静）}

7

疑惧滋生。区域内生物以盟友为目标的检定承受等于其恐惧值的状态减值。恐惧值达到 4 或更高的生物还会陷入困惑。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.oxkb0xCQjaphPk5o]{效果：惊吓（疑神疑鬼）}

8

不见来源的话语或奇怪的声响引发警觉。区域内生物对抗心灵效果的豁免检定承受等于其恐惧值的状态减值。此效果持续 10 分钟。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.SF00Qf1GqfVtYRCk]{效果：惊吓（无形之声）}

9

附近有一处几乎无法察觉的跌倒危险。GM 选择至多 10 个连续相邻的方格，使地面变得不稳，需要保持平衡，否则便可能倒地；具有恐惧值的生物看不出这片区域的异常。察觉这片需要保持平衡的区域所用的察觉 DC，以及通过它所用的特技 DC，均等于队伍等级的标准 DC。区域内生物涉及该处地面的察觉和特技检定，承受等于其恐惧值的状态减值。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.2mJTsbf6Aw72CIT3]{效果：惊吓（不稳地面）}

10

眼前景象并非真实，只有变幻的阴影与想象中的幻影。GM 选择一个具有幻术特征的法术，环阶等于队伍等级的一半，向上取整，并在区域内某处产生该法术的效果。区域内生物对抗幻术的察觉检定和意志豁免，承受等于其恐惧值的状态减值。此效果持续所选法术的通常持续时间。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.saNI79R5H3gEv11R]{效果：惊吓（变幻阴影）}

11

不可能的复苏。区域内一名不久前被杀死或击败的敌方生物意外复活，拥有一半生命值。区域内生物首次看见这个复活生物时，立即陷入惊惧，状态值等于其恐惧值。如果因此陷入惊惧 3 或更高，还会陷入逃跑，直到惊惧状态降至 0。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.hcveoyykcwL4Vc9J]{效果：惊吓（不可思议的复生）}

12

地板上的开口、意料之外的障碍或阻碍，将你像笼中之鼠般困住。区域内生物必须成功通过一次强韧豁免，DC 等于队伍等级的标准 DC，否则陷入禁足；大失败则陷入束缚。脱逃的 DC 等于该强韧豁免的 DC。生物对抗此效果的豁免和脱逃检定，承受等于其恐惧值的状态减值。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.aXGk4vL5sSwrZyge]{效果：惊吓（身陷困境）}

13

虚假的安全感袭来，让人毫无防备地遭受重创。区域内生物下次被敌对效果成功选为目标时，陷入笨拙，持续 1 轮。笨拙状态值等于其恐惧值。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.80XhkLhVoPc4OHRo]{效果：惊吓（虚假安全感）}

14

碎玻璃、歪斜的铁钉或尖锐障碍物挡住去路。GM 选择至多 10 个连续相邻的方格，使之成为危险地形，具有恐惧值的生物看不出这片区域的危险。具有恐惧值的生物每次穿过该危险地形时，受到等于其等级一半乘以恐惧值（最小 1）的伤害。伤害类型取决于危险地形（由 GM 裁定）。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.4pC4qjYY2P5BULEN]{效果：惊吓（危险地形）}

15

一切都快要无法承受，心智饱受折磨。区域内生物受到等于其等级一半乘以恐惧值（最小 1）的持续心灵伤害。移除该持续伤害的纯骰检定 DC 增加等于该生物恐惧值的数值。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.5s9j1AeXtmIK3qRg]{效果：惊吓（心灵煎熬）}

16

突如其来的惊吓，让心怀恐惧者立即措手不及。区域内生物陷入措手不及，持续轮数等于其恐惧值。如果这发生在探索模式中，则改为在离开恐惧区域之前进入遭遇时，陷入措手不及，持续同样的轮数。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.FwPdb2UTSURRDVwF]{效果：惊吓（突如其来的惊吓）}

17

盟友与敌人，有时很难区分，毕竟一切不过是场梦，不是吗？区域内生物以敌人为目标的检定，承受等于其恐惧值的状态减值。恐惧值达到 4 或更高的生物无法用敌对效果指定生物为目标，并且在判断夹击时将所有生物视为盟友。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.gHrcKVEPcSL8okmZ]{效果：惊吓（清醒梦境）}

18

鲜血流淌，有时毫无征兆。区域内生物受到等于其等级一半乘以恐惧值（最小 1）的持续出血伤害。移除该持续伤害的纯骰检定 DC 增加等于该生物恐惧值的数值。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.ErKe5j9gzbley5Zt]{效果：惊吓（鲜血涌流）}

19

最糟糕的时刻出现意外故障，可能意味着必然的灭亡。区域内正在持用或拿着物品的生物必须尝试一次 DC 10 纯骰检定。失败时，其持用或拿着的一件物品变为破损。该纯骰检定，以及尝试修理该物品的 DC，均增加等于此效果发生时该生物恐惧值的数值。 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.A8tIN7ofKnw47lwr]{效果：惊吓（故障）}

20

在表中掷骰两次。此次惊吓同时产生两个结果的效果，后续掷骰再出现本结果时忽略。

4KBPtiwaH0Y5R8Dx.name: 杂兵能力 Underling Abilities
4KBPtiwaH0Y5R8Dx.text:
使用杂兵

杂兵在游戏中的主要用途，是让玩家角色感到自己更强大，并为遭遇增添有趣的变化。有些杂兵可能是应优先消灭的目标，另一些则可以填充场地，让拥有区域效果的角色一次击败多个对手。你也可以直接用一大群杂兵替换遭遇中的一个普通生物，使遭遇显得规模更大，而不明显提高难度。

杂兵也能为其他生物提供辅助。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.ak81yBAnuj9nJGAq]{观察手}杂兵可以让远程威胁更加突出；如果遭遇中有小首领或首领，你可以加入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.SHRWd2rzMOaFGnF1]{喽啰}的指挥能力，让他们在通常的打击与行走之外，有更多动作可用。

另一种用法是让杂兵充当不太重要的盟友角色，例如协助玩家角色的一队城市守卫或士兵。

要简化大量杂兵彼此交战的处理（例如大型战役），你可以在每轮开始时，直接为占优的一方进行一次DC 10的纯骰检定。成功时，他们损失两名杂兵，对方损失三名；失败时则相反。若某一方的优势明显，改为进行DC 5的检定。在这种情况下，除去那些会直接影响玩家角色的杂兵回合，你可以忽略大多数杂兵的回合。

杂兵能力是特殊能力，能够强化杂兵在遭遇中与盟友及其所属兵群成员协同作战的方式。如果一项能力要求进行豁免以抵抗某种效果，其DC等于基础生物等级的标准DC。与具有杂兵特征的生物的其他DC不同，此DC不会降低。除非另有说明，单个杂兵只能拥有一项杂兵能力。

FwFvrdcwEcSaT3WQ.name: 动态遭遇 Dynamic Encounters
FwFvrdcwEcSaT3WQ.text: 传统的开拓者遭遇让玩家角色与生物（也可能有危险）对抗，直至战斗一方败北或被迫逃离。主持人固然能以这种结构设计许多惊险遭遇，但挑战的设计方式并非只有一种。改变利害关系与目标的遭遇，会成为真正令人难忘的事件。本节提供设计复杂、多层次遭遇的框架，以及数种运用这一框架的遭遇类型示例。

IeHcXXNbxFvf8IiE.name: 创建杂兵 Creating Underlings
IeHcXXNbxFvf8IiE.text:
虚拟桌面说明

将附带的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-adventures.pf2e-items.Item.KxysfUjPZGjkvQ3w]{杂兵}效果拖到任意生物身上，并选择杂兵类型，即可将其转变为杂兵。此效果赋予它杂兵特征，将它的等级、所有调整值与难度等级降低 2，把生命值设为基础生物等级的两倍，并授予杂兵防御、劈斩杂兵及杂兵类型能力。

杂兵防御会将基础豁免的成功变为大成功。杂兵豁免大失败，或生物对抗杂兵大成功时，将杂兵的生命值降至 0 的处理需由主持人完成。

遭遇构建器会根据杂兵降低后的等级计算经验值，这与下方的经验值数值不符。

创建杂兵时，选择一个等级不高于队伍等级 + 0 的基础生物，再选择该生物将变成的杂兵类型。所有杂兵都有名为杂兵防御的共同防御机制，而不同类型的杂兵还会改变基础生物的其他方面，包括能力与动作。遭遇通常包含多个杂兵，往往组成一支小队，或侍奉某个更强大的生物，例如首领。同一场遭遇中可以有多种类型的杂兵。

杂兵经验值

单个杂兵的经验值通常等于基础生物经验值除以 4。拥有增援点的兵群，其经验值始终等于基础生物的经验值。

新特征

杂兵 具有杂兵特征的生物比同类其他生物更弱。该生物拥有杂兵防御，使其在战斗中更容易被制服或击败。一些动作与能力专门以具有杂兵特征的生物为目标。对于以杂兵为目标的效果，杂兵被视为等级等于基础生物等级 – 2 的生物，且其所有调整值与难度等级降低 2。

杂兵还有一种杂兵类型，限制其在遭遇中能够采取的动作种类。杂兵兵群通常还拥有增援点，更多同类型杂兵会从那里加入遭遇。
